craft_notes: Sthāyin: un-given nectar (lives given, nectar NOT — the exception that closes the giving-block and the song). Rows: row 3 (steady→not). Close: not (the refusal-word closes: nectar NOT — the whole injunction arc ends on withholding). Rejected: 'withhold the teachings' explained — killed: nectar not kept (the verse withholds the SUBSTANCE, not the manual); 'eternal life' — killed: lives-given kept (āyūṃṣi dīyante: lives ARE given; only nectar is not).

lines: All this left — grasped, this, deer-eyed:
unsteady what? steady this supreme wealth; lives given, nectar not.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvam etat parityajya grāhyam etan mṛgekṣaṇe | kim ebhir asthirair devi sthiram param idaṃ dhanam | prāṇā api pradātavyā na deyaṃ paramāmṛtam

reads_against.argmap: What is the steady wealth? → Unsteady things left, the un-given nectar is the steady wealth.
c1_essence: Unsteady all dropped: the un-given nectar is steady wealth.
